evidence.baseline: This sometimes means accepting structures of accountability and return that conventional investment vehicles do not permit. It sometimes means funding projects whose specific outcomes you cannot predict. It sometimes means trusting builders whose judgment you have come to respect more than your own about how the capital should be deployed.
evidence.shipped: This sometimes means accepting forms of accountability and return that conventional investment vehicles do not permit, funding projects whose outcomes you cannot predict, and trusting builders whose judgment about deployment you have come to respect more than your own.

findings.diagnosis: Three separate concessions, each harder than the last, and the repetition of It sometimes means is what makes them arrive one at a time rather than as a bundle. This is the section's actual ask and its escalation is the argument: give up predictability, then give up measurement, then give up your own judgment. Merged into one sentence with a closing and, the third concession arrives as the last item in a list and loses the weight the baseline built for it. Structures of accountability is also more precise than forms, since the sentence is about legal and financial structure.

findings.summary: The three qualities required of a funder lost the relative pronoun that made them three separate people the sentence is describing.

evidence.baseline: funders who can hold longer time horizons than venture capital typically permits, who can accept that the returns on coherence infrastructure are largely non-financial, and who can resist the institutional pressures that direct most philanthropic and impact capital toward the kinds of projects that are easiest to measure
evidence.shipped: funders who can hold time horizons longer than venture capital typically permits, accept that returns on coherence infrastructure are largely non-financial, and resist institutional pressure to direct philanthropic and impact capital toward projects that are easiest to measure

findings.diagnosis: Repeating who can makes each clause a separate qualification a funder must independently satisfy. Dropped, the three become a compound predicate and read as one profile. The plural institutional pressures also names a set of forces the sentence goes on to describe, where institutional pressure is a mass noun, and most philanthropic and impact capital bounds the claim to a majority where philanthropic and impact capital makes it universal.

findings.summary: Six precisions removed, of which two narrow an empirical claim and one removes the request's central adverb.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression and catalog 4.21 applied to actually and genuinely.
findings.diagnosis: In a position to direct capital describes a structural situation; can direct capital describes an ability, and the distinction matters because the section is addressed to trustees and allocators rather than to people with money. All of and combined are the two words that make the comparison total rather than partial, which is the whole force of the orders-of-magnitude claim. And terms they can actually accept is the request: not terms that sound acceptable, terms a builder can really work under. Actually there is not an intensifier, it is the difference between an offer and a workable offer.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-02 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section is the volume's clearest instance of anaphora carrying an escalation rather than a rhythm. Three It sometimes means sentences ask for three progressively harder concessions, and merging them into one list does not shorten the ask, it flattens its order. Any pass reading catalog 4.9 for repeated openings will find this construction and will be wrong about it, which is why 4.9's retention limb says recurrence may be deliberate.
